result: In `sync_fifo_core`, keep the circular storage and occupancy behavior, but add a `WIDTH`-bit head register that directly drives `out_data`; load it from `in_data` when pushing into an empty FIFO and update it to the next queued word on a pop with remaining occupancy. Handle simultaneous push/pop explicitly, including the full FIFO case and `DEPTH=1`, so the head always represents the oldest queued word after each edge. Preserve the combinational ready/valid equations, synchronous reset priority, minimum transfer age, parameterized widths and depths, and the top’s `// @latency 1` annotation. Expect additional FFs and some next-head selection logic; judge the change by full routed WNS/WHS and resource evidence under the fixed flow.
